topic: Calculating minimum session time for location analytics
summary_markdown: A discussion occurred regarding the required minimum time interval for calculating total traffic across different types of locations (Mall, Airport, Taxi_Rank). It was confirmed that the standard minimum session duration is 8 hours for Malls and Airports in South Africa. An exception was noted: for 'Transport Hub' locations, the minimum session duration is two hours.
decisions: Minimum session time for Mall/Airport/Taxi_Rank in South Africa is 8 hours.
Minimum session time for Transport Hub is 2 hours.
